candidates.title: Purchaser-conditional qualification pool for one alternative concrete-material source
candidates.root_selection_reason: Strong candidate, but source qualification and shared evidence procurement overlap active repository studies. Distinct buyer conditions remain uncertain; do not duplicate an active lane.

candidates.title: Industrial discharge-timing contracts that create treatment-plant flexibility
candidates.root_selection_reason: Meaningful cross-firm physical-control opportunity. A credible construction requires a treatment-process model and calibration beyond the first bounded experiment; retained as next independent candidate, not declared inferior.

candidates.title: Contingent upgrade subscriptions for a group of new electricity loads
candidates.root_selection_reason: Core flexible capacity sharing and financial risk allocation have strong prior art.

candidates.title: Cross-mission bridge-assay commissioning for archived space-biology samples
candidates.root_selection_reason: No specific archived study pair or new scientific comparison was identified; known experimental design dominates the proposed mechanism.

candidates.title: Joint employer rosters that make a new child-care cohort fundable
candidates.root_selection_reason: Selected for a conditional constructive experiment: explicit demand-timing restriction, independently held roster authority, lumpy qualified care opening, finite funding/fallback obligations. No overlap with an active study was found. Construction, not marketing silence, must establish a useful additional arrangement.

candidates.title: Precommitted relief coverage for one-operator water utilities
candidates.root_selection_reason: Important reserve-operator opportunity; existing operator-sharing and mutual-aid arrangements are strong comparators, while geography, fatigue and common outages require a larger physical calibration exercise.

candidates.title: Service-obligation-backed flexible feeder access
candidates.root_selection_reason: Existing flexible grid access already supplies major proposed ingredients.

candidates.title: An insured performance pool for repurposed EV batteries
candidates.root_selection_reason: The insured financed battery-reuse product is already marketed; reject the discovery headline.

candidates.title: A feeder connection cooperative with physically backed curtailment commitments
candidates.root_selection_reason: Provisional arm score retained. Cross-arm reading finds substantial flexible-access prior art; do not use an uncalibrated grid model as the first flagship.

candidates.title: A regional PFAS treatment uptime pool for small water systems
candidates.root_selection_reason: Turnkey/mobile PFAS services are substantial existing alternatives.

candidates.title: Hospital-funded readiness options on qualified injectable manufacturing capacity
candidates.root_selection_reason: Existing hospital-backed manufacturing and supply organizations strongly overlap the proposed arrangement.

candidates.title: A catchment stewardship contract for existing public flood-buyout parcels
candidates.root_selection_reason: Specific rights, hydraulic value and a paying stewardship workload remain too weakly identified for a decisive small experiment.

status: Selected for construction, not accepted as a globally novel market opportunity

root_novelty_assessment.meaning: Familiar integration remains plausible; scoped distinct combination requires constructive evidence. External novelty score 3 or 4 is not earned. Public-documentation absence is not market novelty.

discovery_result.meaning: The selected candidate was not supplied in the shared input. Its absence from eight other generated candidates is descriptive only. Internal unblinded scores and three single runs support no population inference.

researcher_supplied: Broad question, resource limits, evaluation rubric and repository boundary
Post-discovery selection, executable engineering, synthetic cases and economic assumptions
No intended child-care application or future result in the frozen discovery input
agent_contributed: Twelve concrete candidates and adverse prior-art checks
E1 hypothesis that permitted work-roster changes can become a production input to a fundable care cohort
what_changed_now: Capable agent research, coding, tool orchestration and structured evidence can make bespoke cross-party construction inexpensive to attempt. This study does not establish that the arrangement was technically impossible before 2026 or that incumbents cannot construct it.
ordinary_comparator: Give a competent coordinator the identical formulation, information, options and funding rights. An execution tie limits technical advantage; it does not prove that the common discovery input already contained the arrangement. Independent pre-existing delivery would defeat the market-novelty hypothesis.
preservation: All rejected candidates, failed opens and original arm scores remain unchanged. Technical and commercial results are not available at this selection record.
